title: FFmpeg 9.0 — Jean-Baptiste Kempf
excerpt: FFmpeg 9.0 is a major release with a major ABI break, new swscale architecture, more Vulkan work, Dolby Vision Profile 7 handling, and a few fun surprises.

FFmpeg 9.0: swscale, Vulkan, WebP, asm and a big cleanup

FFmpeg 9.0 “Lei” is out.

FFmpeg needs no introduction: it is the engine room of everything multimedia, from every player to every transcoding workflow, and VLC uses libavcodec and libavformat heavily. The FFmpeg and VideoLAN communities have always been close and share quite a few developers, often meeting at FOSDEM and VDD.

FFmpeg 9.0 is a major release. It comes four and a half months after 8.1 “Hoare”, with more than 2200 commits from over 160 authors, touching 1781 files, adding almost 85000 lines and deleting more than 33000. It bumps the major version of all seven libraries (libavutil 61, libavcodec 63, libavformat 63, libavdevice 63, libavfilter 12, libswscale 10, libswresample 7), which means an ABI break across the board, and it means the big cleanup that FFmpeg only allows itself at major bumps.

Let me go through it, subsystem by subsystem.

swscale, rewritten

The most important long-term work in this release is invisible on a feature list: the multi-year rewrite of swscale, led by Niklas Haas, who landed more than 300 commits in libswscale alone this cycle, with Ramiro Polla close behind on the ARM side.

The old swscale is twenty years of bespoke, format-specific conversion code. The new architecture is completely different: every conversion is decomposed into a list of elementary operations (read, swizzle, linear transform, scale, pack…), an optimizer simplifies and splits that list, and a backend then compiles it into a chain of kernels.

In 9.0 this becomes user-visible: the public API gains an SwsBackend selector, and the backends now include the template-based C reference, a fast memcpy path, chained x86 SIMD kernels, chained AArch64 NEON kernels, and a Vulkan SPIR-V backend that compiles the same operation lists into compute shaders, so the exact same conversion graph can run on the CPU or on the GPU. There is also a new SwsScaler enum to pick the scaling algorithm explicitly, instead of the old flags soup.

The correctness engineering underneath is the part I like. The constant math driving every conversion moved to a new 64-bit rational type, computed exactly instead of in floating point, which let a whole series of overflow checks simply disappear. Ask for SWS_BITEXACT and even the Vulkan backend complies, down to decorating its linear arithmetic with SPIR-V NoContraction so the GPU is not allowed to fuse multiply-adds; leave it off and you get a faster matrix-multiply variant instead. And the optimizer learned to split operation lists per plane and into linked subpasses, so a planar conversion compiles into independent kernels per plane instead of one monolithic loop.

The new paths are still gated behind SWS_UNSTABLE, with the legacy code as the stable default. This cycle also brought palette (PAL8) support to the new architecture, with an AVX2 path for palette reads, and proper modelling of interlaced content in the format negotiation. The architecture is now in place.

You should look at Niklas’ talk at the last VDD about this topic.

libavcodec

More than 700 commits landed in libavcodec. The most important ones:

  • FFmpeg can finally decode animated WebP, natively, with a demuxer to go with it. This closes ticket #4907, opened in 2015, a regular of “why does FFmpeg only decode the first frame?” threads for a decade. The patches were originally started by Josef Zlomek, and Ramiro Polla finally finished it: it was more complex than anticipated, notably with RGB and YUV cases.
  • The AAC decoder now handles 960-sample frames, the variant used by DAB+ digital radio.
  • NVENC gains AV1 hierarchical B-frame reference mode, compatibility with Video Codec SDK 13.1, and accepts 12-bit input formats (truncated to 10 bits).
  • We have a video encoder and muxer for the Playdate, the little yellow console with a crank. It produces 1-bit, 400×240 video using delta coding and zlib compression. It is not important, but it is cool.
  • A new decoding API, avcodec_receive_frame_flags(), with an AV_CODEC_RECEIVE_FRAME_FLAG_SYNCHRONOUS flag that bypasses frame-threading delay and returns the next frame as soon as possible. This is useful for low-latency consumers that still want threaded decoding the rest of the time.

Assembly and SIMD: x86, NEON and RISC-V

FFmpeg still writes assembly, and this cycle was busy: nearly 200 commits touched the x86 directories, and about a hundred the ARM ones.

On x86, a large part of the work is Andreas Rheinhardt dragging the oldest DSP code in the tree into the present: the half-pel motion compensation code (hpeldsp and fpel, which date back to the MMX era) was ported to SSE2, the H.264 intra prediction gained AVX2 horizontal predictors, the pp7 postprocessing DCT left MMX behind, and the last MMX remnants were removed from mpegvideoenc. The motion-estimation compare functions gained SSSE3 versions of the median SAD, and the new swscale x86 backend generates its SIMD kernels from NASM macros, including the AVX2 palette-read path mentioned above.

On ARM, the NEON yuv2rgb paths were reworked to process two lines at a time, across packed RGB, planar GBR, 16-bit RGB and yuva420p outputs, including big-endian 16-bit formats. HEVC intra angular modes 10 and 26 got NEON implementations, and the AAC SBR and float DSP loops were re-unrolled to better fill modern pipelines. But the most interesting ARM work hides in swscale. Ramiro Polla built the new AArch64 backend on top of rasm, a small assembler framework with an instruction-level IR and builder API. It generates the chained NEON kernels as assembler text at build time, and is designed to allow runtime code generation later.

RISC-V was quieter in FFmpeg this cycle, with RVV optimizations for hevc_add_res and the pixelutils SAD, plus portability fixes. Most of the RISC-V vector energy in the multimedia ecosystem is currently going into dav1d, where FFmpeg gets it back for free through its dav1d-based AV1 decoding.

Camera raw and FFV1

One of the themes of this release is camera raw video in open source.

The native ProRes RAW decoder, introduced in 8.0, was synchronized with the reference implementation this cycle: it now parses the linearization curve from the bitstream, sets frame cropping, and exports the raw Bayer color parameters through a new AV_FRAME_DATA_RAW_COLOR_PARAMS side data, designed to be codec-specific because ARRIRAW is explicitly on the roadmap. A GPU-accelerated Vulkan decoder is available, as is new VideoToolbox decoding on Apple platforms.

On the other side of the pipeline, FFV1 learned to encode Bayer pixel formats: raw sensor mosaics, compressed losslessly, without debayering first. Lynne implemented it in the native codec, with a per-slice search for the best reversible colour transform coefficients, and in a separate GPU-accelerated Vulkan FFV1 encoder and decoder (yes, FFmpeg encodes and decodes FFV1 on the GPU now). The search runs as its own compute pass. Part of the work was sponsored by the Sovereign Tech Fund. The Vulkan encoder also gained a 32-bit float RGB path with a Rice-plus-remap coding mode, and takes care to preserve denormals when reading raw 16-bit floats. FFV1 is widely used for preservation masters, and losslessly compressing camera sensor data at GPU speed is a useful new capability for digital preservation.

Vulkan and GPUs

The Vulkan work keeps expanding across the codec and filter layers:

  • A new v360_vulkan filter does 360° projection remapping in compute shaders, GPU-accelerating one of the most expensive filters in the tree.
  • APV, Samsung’s professional production codec added in 8.0, gets a Vulkan GPU-accelerated decoder.
  • A significant infrastructure change: runtime shader compilation is gone. All Vulkan shaders are now compiled to SPIR-V at build time, and the remaining filters (scale, nlmeans, blackdetect) were ported accordingly. No more shipping a GLSL compiler at runtime to run a scale filter; the swscale GLSL backend was removed in favour of the SPIR-V one.
  • The Vulkan hwcontext API was modernized for the major bump: VkAccessFlagBits2, publicly exposed queue creation flags, queryable optional instance/device extensions, and new pixel format support (X2RGB10, X2BGR10, XV30, RGBAF16), plus a series of CUDA interoperability fixes.

Vulkan is not the only GPU API in town. AMD’s AMF gains a frame rate converter filter (frc_amf), HDR capabilities in its colour converter (vpp_amf, with new public helpers to translate HDR metadata to and from the AMF representation), and hardware memory mapping support. And the CUDA pipeline gains a new transpose_cuda filter, a generic filtering path in scale_cuda, and end-to-end handling of the 10- and 12-bit 4:2:2 and 4:4:4 formats that recent NVIDIA hardware can finally decode. These professional formats are mapped through NVDEC, the CUDA filters and NVENC alike.

HDR and Dolby Vision

Ten days ago, I wrote about libbluray 1.5.0 exposing Dolby Vision tracks on UHD Blu-rays. FFmpeg 9.0 picks up the other end of that pipeline, and this time the story is complete.

Dolby Vision Profile 7, the flavour used on UHD Blu-ray discs, is a strange beast: a full enhancement-layer HEVC bitstream and the RPU metadata are interleaved inside the base-layer stream, hidden in unspecified NAL unit types 62 and 63. The new dovi_split bitstream filter takes such a stream apart: keep the base layer only and get a plain, standard HEVC stream, or properly separate the layers. Around it, libavformat gained a real model for the thing: a Dolby Vision stream group (a generalization of the LCEVC stream groups into AVStreamGroupLayeredVideo), detected when demuxing MP4, MPEG-TS and Matroska, and written out again, including the hvcE enhancement-layer configuration, when muxing to MP4 or Matroska. This makes it possible to demux, split and remux these streams while keeping the signaling intact.

On the metadata front, 9.0 adds parsing, writing and passthrough for SMPTE 2094-50 dynamic HDR metadata, another SMPTE 2094 format alongside HDR10+, down to encoding with libaom and libvpx, Matroska block additions, and ffprobe output. The spec is being finalized in the open, on GitHub of all places. Yes, SMPTE drafts standards on GitHub now. The whole ITU-T T.35 dynamic metadata zoo, including HDR10+, China’s HDR Vivid, AOM film grain and Active Format Description, is now parsed through one unified set of helpers instead of being reimplemented codec by codec. And if your file carries wrong static HDR metadata, the ffmpeg CLI gains per-stream -mastering_display and -content_light input overrides to correct the metadata on input, which anyone who has handled badly-mastered HDR files will appreciate.

libavformat

Close to 400 commits landed in libavformat. Beyond the Dolby Vision work above:

  • A new demuxer command API (avformat_send_command() / avformat_receive_command_reply()) lets applications talk to a running demuxer. The first user is RTSP, exposing SET_PARAMETER, so interactive camera control no longer needs an out-of-band connection. The design is deliberately asynchronous: you keep reading packets between the command and its reply.
  • LCEVC enhancement layers can now be muxed as proper tracks in MP4, and as ITU-T T.35 block additions in Matroska, completing the LCEVC chain that started two releases ago.
  • MP4/MOV gained TREF stream groups to model track references, so timed metadata streams (think EXIF or camera telemetry) stay attached to the media they describe, version 1 chnl boxes, stsd version 2 for more than two audio channels, and export of initial padding and trailing-sample trimming for gapless audio.
  • A new shared: protocol implements a concurrent block cache: thread-safe and cross-process, so several FFmpeg instances reading the same remote stream can share a single cache file. It is memory-mapped, with a nice side effect: once the stream has been fully read, the cache file is a working copy of the streamed file. By Niklas Haas, when he is not rewriting swscale.
  • IAMF, the Alliance for Open Media’s immersive audio format (the one underneath Eclipsa Audio), got its dynamic parameters, including mix gain, demixing information and recon gain, exposed as proper frame side data, printable by ffprobe and the showinfo filter; by Marvin Scholz. The IAMF muxer now enforces the format’s fixed frame size through a new AVFMT_FIXED_FRAMESIZE capability flag, instead of silently producing broken files.
  • On the network side: the WHIP muxer now requires and verifies the remote DTLS fingerprint from the SDP answer, mbedTLS got a fix to actually check the certificate verification result on external sockets, and RTMP, FTP and RTSP all received input-validation hardening.

The big cleanup

Everything deprecated during the 8.x cycle is gone, and the list is long.

On the command line, -vsync is finally removed (use -fps_mode), along with -top, -qphist, -filter_complex_script and -adrift_threshold. The OpenMAX encoders are removed. The NPP filters (scale_npp, scale2ref_npp, sharpen_npp, transpose_npp) are gone with the rest of the libnpp support, deprecated last September; the transpose_cuda filter mentioned above picks up where transpose_npp left off, without the external dependency. The packed-YUV oddities v308/v408/v410 lose their dedicated codecs. And NVENC drops the old preset aliases, the legacy rate-control modes and support for SDKs older than 11.1.

One behaviour change deserves everyone’s attention: FFmpeg now verifies TLS peer certificates by default. This was announced with 8.0 and applied at this bump, exactly as promised. If your scripts talk to servers with broken certificates, they were living on borrowed time anyway.

My two favourite removals, though, are pure FFmpeg lore:

  • The standalone CELT decoder is gone (this does not affect Opus, which contains its own CELT). The commit message notes it had actually been broken since 2014, “and no one noticed and complained”. Eleven years of silent bitrot, removed by VideoLAN’s own Marvin Scholz.
  • The Sonic codecs, Michael Niedermayer’s experimental codec family from the early 2000s, are removed too. The removal had been scheduled for the previous major bump and missed the deadline. If you have Sonic files somewhere, and statistically you do not, transcode them with an 8.x release while you can.

The command line

The -re/-readrate machinery was reworked to throttle on the slowest stream instead of the fastest, skipping finished and not-yet-started streams. If you have ever seen a live restream starve because of a sparse subtitle track, this is your fix. ffprobe learned to print the new side data types (SMPTE 2094-50, IAMF mix gain and demixing parameters, downmix info), and the ffmpeg CLI can now create LCEVC stream groups when muxing.

And the DNN filters gain an ONNX Runtime backend with CUDA and DirectML execution providers, so you can run ONNX models directly in a filter graph for super-resolution, denoising or background removal, without converting them for TensorFlow or OpenVINO first. Combined with the Whisper filter from 8.0, the filter graph is becoming a decent place to run inference next to your decode loop.

Under the hood

Some less visible changes are worth mentioning too:

  • FFmpeg’s assembly tests now use the standalone checkasm library, the project I mentioned in the dav1d 1.5.4 post: born in x264, rewritten in FFmpeg, relicensed for dav1d, and now maintained once, for everyone.
  • Development now runs on FFmpeg’s own Forgejo instance at code.ffmpeg.org, alongside the mailing list; GitHub pull requests “will be ignored”.
  • Among the 160+ contributors of this cycle sits an automated one: a bug-finding bot landed nine accepted hardening patches in the demuxers and protocols, alongside the continuous stream of fuzzing fixes from OSS-Fuzz.

Conclusion

FFmpeg 9.0 is a substantial release, with new features as well as a lot of cleanup. The ABI break means distributions and applications will take some time to migrate the seven new sonames, and VLC will follow.

The full Changelog is worth a read, and so is the git log; congratulations to the 160+ people who wrote this release, and in particular to Niklas Haas, Andreas Rheinhardt, Michael Niedermayer, James Almer, Lynne, Marvin Scholz and Ramiro Polla, who top a very long list, several of them doing part of this work at FFlabs and/or VideoLabs.

The code is, as always, open source. Patches welcome.

Development now runs on FFmpeg’s own Forgejo instance at code.ffmpeg.org, alongside the mailing list; GitHub pull requests “will be ignored”. Among the 160+ contributors of this cycle sits an automated one: a bug-finding bot landed nine accepted hardening patches in the demuxers and protocols, alongside the continuous stream of fuzzing fixes from OSS-Fuzz. Conclusion FFmpeg 9.0 is a substantial release, with new features as well as a lot of cleanup. The ABI break means distributions and applications will take some time to migrate the seven new sonames, and VLC will follow. The full Changelog is worth a read, and so is the git log; congratulations to the 160+ people who wrote this release, and in particular to Niklas Haas, Andreas Rheinhardt, Michael Niedermayer, James Almer, Lynne, Marvin Scholz and Ramiro Polla, who top a very long list, several of them doing part of this work at FFlabs and/or VideoLabs. The code is, as always, open source. Patches welcome.

blocks.html_en: The old swscale is twenty years of bespoke, format-specific conversion code. The new architecture is completely different: every conversion is decomposed into a list of elementary operations (read, swizzle, linear transform, scale, pack…), an optimizer simplifies and splits that list, and a backend then compiles it into a chain of kernels.

blocks.html_en: The correctness engineering underneath is the part I like. The constant math driving every conversion moved to a new 64-bit rational type, computed exactly instead of in floating point, which let a whole series of overflow checks simply disappear. Ask for SWS_BITEXACT and even the Vulkan backend complies, down to decorating its linear arithmetic with SPIR-V NoContraction so the GPU is not allowed to fuse multiply-adds; leave it off and you get a faster matrix-multiply variant instead. And the optimizer learned to split operation lists per plane and into linked subpasses, so a planar conversion compiles into independent kernels per plane instead of one monolithic loop.

blocks.html_en: On the other side of the pipeline, FFV1 learned to encode Bayer pixel formats: raw sensor mosaics, compressed losslessly, without debayering first. Lynne implemented it in the native codec, with a per-slice search for the best reversible colour transform coefficients, and in a separate GPU-accelerated Vulkan FFV1 encoder and decoder (yes, FFmpeg encodes and decodes FFV1 on the GPU now). The search runs as its own compute pass. Part of the work was sponsored by the Sovereign Tech Fund. The Vulkan encoder also gained a 32-bit float RGB path with a Rice-plus-remap coding mode, and takes care to preserve denormals when reading raw 16-bit floats. FFV1 is widely used for preservation masters, and losslessly compressing camera sensor data at GPU speed is a useful new capability for digital preservation.

sentences.zh: APV 是三星在 8.0 中添加的专业生产编解码器，配备了 Vulkan GPU 加速解码器。

blocks.html_en: • A significant infrastructure change: runtime shader compilation is gone. All Vulkan shaders are now compiled to SPIR-V at build time, and the remaining filters (scale, nlmeans, blackdetect) were ported accordingly. No more shipping a GLSL compiler at runtime to run a scale filter; the swscale GLSL backend was removed in favour of the SPIR-V one.

sentences.en: A significant infrastructure change: runtime shader compilation is gone.
sentences.zh: 一个重大的基础设施变化：运行时着色器编译消失了。

sentences.en: All Vulkan shaders are now compiled to SPIR-V at build time, and the remaining filters (scale, nlmeans, blackdetect) were ported accordingly.
sentences.zh: 现在，所有 Vulkan 着色器都在构建时编译为 SPIR-V，并且其余过滤器（scale、nlmeans、blackdetect）也进行了相应移植。

sentences.en: No more shipping a GLSL compiler at runtime to run a scale filter; the swscale GLSL backend was removed in favour of the SPIR-V one.
sentences.zh: 不再需要在运行时运送 GLSL 编译器来运行比例过滤器； swscale GLSL 后端被删除，取而代之的是 SPIR-V 后端。

blocks.html_en: • The Vulkan hwcontext API was modernized for the major bump: VkAccessFlagBits2, publicly exposed queue creation flags, queryable optional instance/device extensions, and new pixel format support (X2RGB10, X2BGR10, XV30, RGBAF16), plus a series of CUDA interoperability fixes.

sentences.en: The Vulkan hwcontext API was modernized for the major bump: VkAccessFlagBits2, publicly exposed queue creation flags, queryable optional instance/device extensions, and new pixel format support (X2RGB10, X2BGR10, XV30, RGBAF16), plus a series of CUDA interoperability fixes.
sentences.zh: Vulkan hwcontext API 针对重大改进进行了现代化：VkAccessFlagBits2、公开公开的队列创建标志、可查询的可选实例/设备扩展、新的像素格式支持（X2RGB10、X2BGR10、XV30、RGBAF16），以及一系列 CUDA 互操作性修复。

blocks.html_en: Vulkan is not the only GPU API in town. AMD’s AMF gains a frame rate converter filter (frc_amf), HDR capabilities in its colour converter (vpp_amf, with new public helpers to translate HDR metadata to and from the AMF representation), and hardware memory mapping support. And the CUDA pipeline gains a new transpose_cuda filter, a generic filtering path in scale_cuda, and end-to-end handling of the 10- and 12-bit 4:2:2 and 4:4:4 formats that recent NVIDIA hardware can finally decode. These professional formats are mapped through NVDEC, the CUDA filters and NVENC alike.

sentences.en: Vulkan is not the only GPU API in town.
sentences.zh: Vulkan 并不是唯一的 GPU API。

sentences.en: AMD’s AMF gains a frame rate converter filter (frc_amf), HDR capabilities in its colour converter (vpp_amf, with new public helpers to translate HDR metadata to and from the AMF representation), and hardware memory mapping support.
sentences.zh: AMD 的 AMF 获得了帧速率转换器过滤器 (frc_amf)、颜色转换器中的 HDR 功能（vpp_amf，以及新的公共帮助程序，用于将 HDR 元数据与 AMF 表示进行相互转换）以及硬件内存映射支持。

sentences.en: And the CUDA pipeline gains a new transpose_cuda filter, a generic filtering path in scale_cuda, and end-to-end handling of the 10- and 12-bit 4:2:2 and 4:4:4 formats that recent NVIDIA hardware can finally decode.
sentences.zh: CUDA 管道获得了一个新的 transpose_cuda 过滤器、scale_cuda 中的通用过滤路径，以及最新 NVIDIA 硬件最终可以解码的 10 位和 12 位 4:2:2 和 4:4:4 格式的端到端处理。

sentences.en: These professional formats are mapped through NVDEC, the CUDA filters and NVENC alike.
sentences.zh: 这些专业格式通过 NVDEC、CUDA 过滤器和 NVENC 等进行映射。

sentences.en: HDR and Dolby Vision
sentences.zh: HDR 和杜比视界

blocks.html_en: Ten days ago, I wrote about libbluray 1.5.0 exposing Dolby Vision tracks on UHD Blu-rays. FFmpeg 9.0 picks up the other end of that pipeline, and this time the story is complete.

sentences.en: Ten days ago, I wrote about libbluray 1.5.0 exposing Dolby Vision tracks on UHD Blu-rays.
sentences.zh: 十天前，我写了一篇有关 libbluray 1.5.0 在 UHD 蓝光光盘上公开杜比视界轨道的文章。

blocks.html_en: Dolby Vision Profile 7, the flavour used on UHD Blu-ray discs, is a strange beast: a full enhancement-layer HEVC bitstream and the RPU metadata are interleaved inside the base-layer stream, hidden in unspecified NAL unit types 62 and 63. The new dovi_split bitstream filter takes such a stream apart: keep the base layer only and get a plain, standard HEVC stream, or properly separate the layers. Around it, libavformat gained a real model for the thing: a Dolby Vision stream group (a generalization of the LCEVC stream groups into AVStreamGroupLayeredVideo), detected when demuxing MP4, MPEG-TS and Matroska, and written out again, including the hvcE enhancement-layer configuration, when muxing to MP4 or Matroska. This makes it possible to demux, split and remux these streams while keeping the signaling intact.

sentences.en: Dolby Vision Profile 7, the flavour used on UHD Blu-ray discs, is a strange beast: a full enhancement-layer HEVC bitstream and the RPU metadata are interleaved inside the base-layer stream, hidden in unspecified NAL unit types 62 and 63.
sentences.zh: 杜比视界配置文件 7（UHD 蓝光光盘上使用的风格）是一种奇怪的野兽：完整的增强层 HEVC 比特流和 RPU 元数据在基础层流内交错，隐藏在未指定的 NAL 单元类型 62 和 63 中。

sentences.en: The new dovi_split bitstream filter takes such a stream apart: keep the base layer only and get a plain, standard HEVC stream, or properly separate the layers.
sentences.zh: 新的 dovi_split 比特流过滤器将这样的流分开：仅保留基础层并获得普通的标准 HEVC 流，或正确分离各层。

sentences.en: Around it, libavformat gained a real model for the thing: a Dolby Vision stream group (a generalization of the LCEVC stream groups into AVStreamGroupLayeredVideo), detected when demuxing MP4, MPEG-TS and Matroska, and written out again, including the hvcE enhancement-layer configuration, when muxing to MP4 or Matroska.
sentences.zh: 围绕它，libavformat 获得了一个真实的模型：杜比视觉流组（LCEVC 流组到 AVStreamGroupLayeredVideo 的概括），在解复用 MP4、MPEG-TS 和 Matroska 时检测到，并在复用到 MP4 或 Matroska 时再次写入，包括 hvcE 增强层配置。

sentences.en: This makes it possible to demux, split and remux these streams while keeping the signaling intact.
sentences.zh: 这使得可以对这些流进行解复用、分割和重新复用，同时保持信令完好无损。

blocks.html_en: On the metadata front, 9.0 adds parsing, writing and passthrough for SMPTE 2094-50 dynamic HDR metadata, another SMPTE 2094 format alongside HDR10+, down to encoding with libaom and libvpx, Matroska block additions, and ffprobe output. The spec is being finalized in the open, on GitHub of all places. Yes, SMPTE drafts standards on GitHub now. The whole ITU-T T.35 dynamic metadata zoo, including HDR10+, China’s HDR Vivid, AOM film grain and Active Format Description, is now parsed through one unified set of helpers instead of being reimplemented codec by codec. And if your file carries wrong static HDR metadata, the ffmpeg CLI gains per-stream -mastering_display and -content_light input overrides to correct the metadata on input, which anyone who has handled badly-mastered HDR files will appreciate.

sentences.en: On the metadata front, 9.0 adds parsing, writing and passthrough for SMPTE 2094-50 dynamic HDR metadata, another SMPTE 2094 format alongside HDR10+, down to encoding with libaom and libvpx, Matroska block additions, and ffprobe output.
sentences.zh: 在元数据方面，9.0 添加了 SMPTE 2094-50 动态 HDR 元数据（与 HDR10+ 并列的另一种 SMPTE 2094 格式）的解析、写入和直通，以及使用 libaom 和 libvpx 进行编码、Matroska 块添加和 ffprobe 输出。

sentences.en: The spec is being finalized in the open, on GitHub of all places.
sentences.zh: 该规范正在所有地方的 GitHub 上公开最终确定。

sentences.en: Yes, SMPTE drafts standards on GitHub now.
sentences.zh: 是的，SMPTE 现在在 GitHub 上起草标准。

sentences.en: The whole ITU-T T.35 dynamic metadata zoo, including HDR10+, China’s HDR Vivid, AOM film grain and Active Format Description, is now parsed through one unified set of helpers instead of being reimplemented codec by codec.
sentences.zh: 整个 ITU-T T.35 动态元数据动物园，包括 HDR10+、中国的 HDR Vivid、AOM 胶片颗粒和活动格式描述，现在通过一组统一的助手进行解析，而不是由编解码器重新实现。

sentences.en: And if your file carries wrong static HDR metadata, the ffmpeg CLI gains per-stream -mastering_display and -content_light input overrides to correct the metadata on input, which anyone who has handled badly-mastered HDR files will appreciate.
sentences.zh: 如果您的文件携带错误的静态 HDR 元数据，则 ffmpeg CLI 会获得每个流的 -mastering_display 和 -content_light 输入覆盖，以更正输入上的元数据，任何处理过不良掌握的 HDR 文件的人都会欣赏这一点。

blocks.html_en: libavformat

sentences.en: libavformat
sentences.zh: libav格式

blocks.html_en: Close to 400 commits landed in libavformat. Beyond the Dolby Vision work above:

sentences.en: Close to 400 commits landed in libavformat.

sentences.en: Beyond the Dolby Vision work above:
sentences.zh: 除了上述杜比视界工作之外：

blocks.html_en: • A new demuxer command API (avformat_send_command() / avformat_receive_command_reply()) lets applications talk to a running demuxer. The first user is RTSP, exposing SET_PARAMETER, so interactive camera control no longer needs an out-of-band connection. The design is deliberately asynchronous: you keep reading packets between the command and its reply.

sentences.en: A new demuxer command API (avformat_send_command() / avformat_receive_command_reply()) lets applications talk to a running demuxer.
sentences.zh: 新的解复用器命令 API (avformat_send_command() / avformat_receive_command_reply()) 允许应用程序与正在运行的解复用器通信。

sentences.en: The first user is RTSP, exposing SET_PARAMETER, so interactive camera control no longer needs an out-of-band connection.
sentences.zh: 第一个用户是 RTSP，公开 SET_PARAMETER，因此交互式摄像机控制不再需要带外连接。

sentences.en: The design is deliberately asynchronous: you keep reading packets between the command and its reply.
sentences.zh: 该设计故意是异步的：您在命令及其回复之间不断读取数据包。

blocks.html_en: • LCEVC enhancement layers can now be muxed as proper tracks in MP4, and as ITU-T T.35 block additions in Matroska, completing the LCEVC chain that started two releases ago.

sentences.en: LCEVC enhancement layers can now be muxed as proper tracks in MP4, and as ITU-T T.35 block additions in Matroska, completing the LCEVC chain that started two releases ago.
sentences.zh: LCEVC 增强层现在可以作为 MP4 中的正确轨道进行复用，并作为 Matroska 中的 ITU-T T.35 块添加进行复用，从而完成两个版本前开始的 LCEVC 链。

blocks.html_en: • MP4/MOV gained TREF stream groups to model track references, so timed metadata streams (think EXIF or camera telemetry) stay attached to the media they describe, version 1 chnl boxes, stsd version 2 for more than two audio channels, and export of initial padding and trailing-sample trimming for gapless audio.

sentences.en: MP4/MOV gained TREF stream groups to model track references, so timed metadata streams (think EXIF or camera telemetry) stay attached to the media they describe, version 1 chnl boxes, stsd version 2 for more than two audio channels, and export of initial padding and trailing-sample trimming for gapless audio.
sentences.zh: MP4/MOV 获得了 TREF 流组来对轨道引用进行建模，因此定时元数据流（例如 EXIF 或摄像机遥测）始终附加到它们所描述的媒体、版本 1 chnl 框、stsd 版本 2（用于两个以上音频通道）以及导出初始填充和尾随样本修剪以实现无间隙音频。

blocks.html_en: • A new shared: protocol implements a concurrent block cache: thread-safe and cross-process, so several FFmpeg instances reading the same remote stream can share a single cache file. It is memory-mapped, with a nice side effect: once the stream has been fully read, the cache file is a working copy of the streamed file. By Niklas Haas, when he is not rewriting swscale.

sentences.en: A new shared: protocol implements a concurrent block cache: thread-safe and cross-process, so several FFmpeg instances reading the same remote stream can share a single cache file.
sentences.zh: 新的共享：协议实现了并发块缓存：线程安全且跨进程，因此读取同一远程流的多个 FFmpeg 实例可以共享单个缓存文件。

sentences.en: It is memory-mapped, with a nice side effect: once the stream has been fully read, the cache file is a working copy of the streamed file.
sentences.zh: 它是内存映射的，有一个很好的副作用：一旦流被完全读取，缓存文件就是流文件的工作副本。

sentences.en: By Niklas Haas, when he is not rewriting swscale.
sentences.zh: 作者：Niklas Haas，当时他没有重写 swscale。

blocks.html_en: • IAMF, the Alliance for Open Media’s immersive audio format (the one underneath Eclipsa Audio), got its dynamic parameters, including mix gain, demixing information and recon gain, exposed as proper frame side data, printable by ffprobe and the showinfo filter; by Marvin Scholz. The IAMF muxer now enforces the format’s fixed frame size through a new AVFMT_FIXED_FRAMESIZE capability flag, instead of silently producing broken files.

sentences.en: IAMF, the Alliance for Open Media’s immersive audio format (the one underneath Eclipsa Audio), got its dynamic parameters, including mix gain, demixing information and recon gain, exposed as proper frame side data, printable by ffprobe and the showinfo filter; by Marvin Scholz.
sentences.zh: IAMF，开放媒体联盟的沉浸式音频格式（Eclipsa Audio 下的格式），获得了其动态参数，包括混合增益、解混合信息和侦查增益，以正确的帧侧数据形式公开，可通过 ffprobe 和 showinfo 过滤器打印；马文·肖尔茨着。

sentences.en: The IAMF muxer now enforces the format’s fixed frame size through a new AVFMT_FIXED_FRAMESIZE capability flag, instead of silently producing broken files.
sentences.zh: IAMF 复用器现在通过新的 AVFMT_FIXED_FRAMESIZE 功能标志强制执行格式的固定帧大小，而不是默默地生成损坏的文件。

blocks.html_en: • On the network side: the WHIP muxer now requires and verifies the remote DTLS fingerprint from the SDP answer, mbedTLS got a fix to actually check the certificate verification result on external sockets, and RTMP, FTP and RTSP all received input-validation hardening.

sentences.en: On the network side: the WHIP muxer now requires and verifies the remote DTLS fingerprint from the SDP answer, mbedTLS got a fix to actually check the certificate verification result on external sockets, and RTMP, FTP and RTSP all received input-validation hardening.
sentences.zh: 在网络方面：WHIP 复用器现在需要并验证来自 SDP 答案的远程 DTLS 指纹，mbedTLS 得到了修复以实际检查外部套接字上的证书验证结果，RTMP、FTP 和 RTSP 都收到了输入验证强化。

blocks.html_en: The big cleanup

sentences.en: The big cleanup
sentences.zh: 大清理

blocks.html_en: Everything deprecated during the 8.x cycle is gone, and the list is long.

sentences.en: Everything deprecated during the 8.x cycle is gone, and the list is long.
sentences.zh: 8.x 周期中弃用的所有内容都消失了，而且列表很长。

blocks.html_en: On the command line, -vsync is finally removed (use -fps_mode), along with -top, -qphist, -filter_complex_script and -adrift_threshold. The OpenMAX encoders are removed. The NPP filters (scale_npp, scale2ref_npp, sharpen_npp, transpose_npp) are gone with the rest of the libnpp support, deprecated last September; the transpose_cuda filter mentioned above picks up where transpose_npp left off, without the external dependency. The packed-YUV oddities v308/v408/v410 lose their dedicated codecs. And NVENC drops the old preset aliases, the legacy rate-control modes and support for SDKs older than 11.1.

sentences.en: On the command line, -vsync is finally removed (use -fps_mode), along with -top, -qphist, -filter_complex_script and -adrift_threshold.
sentences.zh: 在命令行上，-vsync 最终被删除（使用 -fps_mode），以及 -top、-qphist、-filter_complex_script 和 -adrift_threshold。

sentences.en: The OpenMAX encoders are removed.
sentences.zh: OpenMAX 编码器已被删除。

sentences.en: The NPP filters (scale_npp, scale2ref_npp, sharpen_npp, transpose_npp) are gone with the rest of the libnpp support, deprecated last September; the transpose_cuda filter mentioned above picks up where transpose_npp left off, without the external dependency.
sentences.zh: NPP 过滤器（scale_npp、scale2ref_npp、sharpen_npp、transpose_npp）与 libnpp 支持的其余部分一起消失，已于去年 9 月弃用；上面提到的 transpose_cuda 过滤器从 transpose_npp 停止的地方开始，没有外部依赖。

sentences.en: The packed-YUV oddities v308/v408/v410 lose their dedicated codecs.
sentences.zh: 打包的 YUV 怪异 v308/v408/v410 失去了专用编解码器。

sentences.en: And NVENC drops the old preset aliases, the legacy rate-control modes and support for SDKs older than 11.1.
sentences.zh: NVENC 放弃了旧的预设别名、旧的速率控制模式以及对 11.1 之前版本的 SDK 的支持。

blocks.html_en: One behaviour change deserves everyone’s attention: FFmpeg now verifies TLS peer certificates by default. This was announced with 8.0 and applied at this bump, exactly as promised. If your scripts talk to servers with broken certificates, they were living on borrowed time anyway.

sentences.en: One behaviour change deserves everyone’s attention: FFmpeg now verifies TLS peer certificates by default.
sentences.zh: 一项行为变化值得大家关注：FFmpeg 现在默认验证 TLS 对等证书。

sentences.en: This was announced with 8.0 and applied at this bump, exactly as promised.
sentences.zh: 这是在 8.0 中宣布的，并在这次升级中应用，完全按照承诺。

sentences.en: If your scripts talk to servers with broken certificates, they were living on borrowed time anyway.
sentences.zh: 如果您的脚本与证书损坏的服务器通信，那么它们无论如何都是靠借来的时间生存的。

blocks.html_en: My two favourite removals, though, are pure FFmpeg lore:

sentences.en: My two favourite removals, though, are pure FFmpeg lore:
sentences.zh: 不过，我最喜欢的两个删除是纯粹的 FFmpeg 传说：

blocks.html_en: • The standalone CELT decoder is gone (this does not affect Opus, which contains its own CELT). The commit message notes it had actually been broken since 2014, “and no one noticed and complained”. Eleven years of silent bitrot, removed by VideoLAN’s own Marvin Scholz.

sentences.en: The standalone CELT decoder is gone (this does not affect Opus, which contains its own CELT).
sentences.zh: 独立的 CELT 解码器消失了（这不会影响 Opus，它包含自己的 CELT）。

sentences.en: The commit message notes it had actually been broken since 2014, “and no one noticed and complained”.
sentences.zh: 提交消息指出，它实际上自 2014 年以来就已被破坏，“没有人注意到并抱怨”。

sentences.en: Eleven years of silent bitrot, removed by VideoLAN’s own Marvin Scholz.
sentences.zh: 十一年的无声比特腐烂，被 VideoLAN 自己的马文·肖尔茨 (Marvin Scholz) 删除了。

blocks.html_en: • The Sonic codecs, Michael Niedermayer’s experimental codec family from the early 2000s, are removed too. The removal had been scheduled for the previous major bump and missed the deadline. If you have Sonic files somewhere, and statistically you do not, transcode them with an 8.x release while you can.

sentences.en: The Sonic codecs, Michael Niedermayer’s experimental codec family from the early 2000s, are removed too.
sentences.zh: Sonic 编解码器（Michael Niedermayer 在 2000 年代初的实验性编解码器系列）也被删除。

sentences.en: The removal had been scheduled for the previous major bump and missed the deadline.
sentences.zh: 拆除工作原定于上一次重大突破时进行，但错过了最后期限。

sentences.en: If you have Sonic files somewhere, and statistically you do not, transcode them with an 8.x release while you can.
sentences.zh: 如果您在某个地方有 Sonic 文件，并且从统计数据来看您没有，请尽可能使用 8.x 版本对它们进行转码。

blocks.html_en: The -re/-readrate machinery was reworked to throttle on the slowest stream instead of the fastest, skipping finished and not-yet-started streams. If you have ever seen a live restream starve because of a sparse subtitle track, this is your fix. ffprobe learned to print the new side data types (SMPTE 2094-50, IAMF mix gain and demixing parameters, downmix info), and the ffmpeg CLI can now create LCEVC stream groups when muxing.

sentences.en: The -re/-readrate machinery was reworked to throttle on the slowest stream instead of the fastest, skipping finished and not-yet-started streams.
sentences.zh: -re/-readrate 机制经过重新设计，以限制最慢的流而不是最快的流，跳过已完成和尚未启动的流。

sentences.en: If you have ever seen a live restream starve because of a sparse subtitle track, this is your fix.
sentences.zh: 如果您曾经遇到过由于字幕轨道稀疏而无法进行实时重播的情况，那么这就是您的解决方法。

sentences.en: ffprobe learned to print the new side data types (SMPTE 2094-50, IAMF mix gain and demixing parameters, downmix info), and the ffmpeg CLI can now create LCEVC stream groups when muxing.
sentences.zh: ffprobe 学会了打印新的辅助数据类型（SMPTE 2094-50、IAMF 混合增益和解混合参数、缩混信息），并且 ffmpeg CLI 现在可以在复用时创建 LCEVC 流组。

blocks.html_en: And the DNN filters gain an ONNX Runtime backend with CUDA and DirectML execution providers, so you can run ONNX models directly in a filter graph for super-resolution, denoising or background removal, without converting them for TensorFlow or OpenVINO first. Combined with the Whisper filter from 8.0, the filter graph is becoming a decent place to run inference next to your decode loop.

sentences.en: And the DNN filters gain an ONNX Runtime backend with CUDA and DirectML execution providers, so you can run ONNX models directly in a filter graph for super-resolution, denoising or background removal, without converting them for TensorFlow or OpenVINO first.
sentences.zh: DNN 过滤器获得带有 CUDA 和 DirectML 执行提供程序的 ONNX 运行时后端，因此您可以直接在过滤器图中运行 ONNX 模型以实现超分辨率、去噪或背景去除，而无需先将其转换为 TensorFlow 或 OpenVINO。

sentences.en: Combined with the Whisper filter from 8.0, the filter graph is becoming a decent place to run inference next to your decode loop.
sentences.zh: 与 8.0 中的 Whisper 过滤器相结合，过滤器图正在成为在解码循环旁边运行推理的好地方。

content_html_zh:
FFmpeg 9.0：swscale、Vulkan、WebP、asm 和大清理

FFmpeg 9.0“雷”已发布。

FFmpeg 无需介绍：它是所有多媒体的引擎室，从每个播放器到每个转码工作流程，而 VLC 大量使用 libavcodec 和 libavformat。 FFmpeg 和 VideoLAN 社区一直关系密切，并且共享相当多的开发人员，经常在 FOSDEM 和 VDD 上聚会。

FFmpeg 9.0 是一个主要版本。 它是在 8.1“Hoare”发布四个半月后发布的，来自 160 多名作者的 2200 多次提交，涉及 1781 个文件，添加了近 85000 行并删除了 33000 多行。 它提升了所有七个库（libavutil 61、libavcodec 63、libavformat 63、libavdevice 63、libavfilter 12、libswscale 10、libswresample 7）的主要版本，这意味着 ABI 全面中断，也意味着 FFmpeg 只允许在重大变更时进行大清理。

让我逐个子系统地介绍一下。

swscale，重写

此版本中最重要的长期工作在功能列表中是不可见的：由 Niklas Haas 领导的 swscale 的多年重写，他在本周期仅在 libswscale 中就完成了 300 多次提交，ARM 方面的 Ramiro Polla 紧随其后。

旧的 swscale 是二十年来定制的、特定于格式的转换代码。 新的架构完全不同：每次转换都被分解为基本操作列表（读取、混合、线性变换、缩放、打包……），优化器简化并拆分该列表，然后后端将其编译为内核链。

在 9.0 中，这变得用户可见：公共 API 获得了 SwsBackend 选择器，后端现在包括基于模板的 C 引用、快速 memcpy 路径、链式 x86 SIMD 内核、链式 AArch64 NEON 内核以及将相同操作列表编译到计算着色器中的 Vulkan SPIR-V 后端，因此完全相同的转换图可以在 CPU 或 GPU 上运行。 还有一个新的 SwsScaler 枚举可以显式选择缩放算法，而不是旧的标志汤。

下面的正确性工程是我喜欢的部分。 驱动每次转换的常数数学转移到新的 64 位有理数类型，精确计算而不是浮点计算，这让一系列溢出检查完全消失。 请求 SWS_BITEXACT，甚至 Vulkan 后端也会遵守，甚至用 SPIR-V NoContraction 修饰其线性算术，因此不允许 GPU 融合乘加运算；去掉它，你会得到一个更快的矩阵乘法变体。 优化器学会了将每个平面的操作列表拆分为链接的子通道，因此平面转换会编译为每个平面的独立内核，而不是一个整体循环。

新路径仍然被控制在 SWS_UNSTABLE 后面，旧代码作为稳定的默认值。 此周期还为新架构带来了调色板 (PAL8) 支持，并提供用于调色板读取的 AVX2 路径，以及格式协商中交错内容的正确建模。 该架构现已就位。

你应该看看 Niklas 在上一个 VDD 上关于这个主题的演讲。

libav编解码器

libavcodec 中有超过 700 个提交。 最重要的：

  • FFmpeg 最终可以使用解复用器来本地解码动画 WebP。 2015 年开放的票#4907 到此结束，这是“为什么 FFmpeg 只解码第一帧？”的常规问题。 线程十年了。 这些补丁最初是由 Josef Zlomek 开始的，Ramiro Polla 最终完成了它：它比预期更复杂，特别是在 RGB 和 YUV 情况下。
  • AAC 解码器现在可处理 960 个样本帧，这是 DAB+ 数字收音机使用的变体。
  • NVENC 获得 AV1 分层 B 帧参考模式，与 Video Codec SDK 13.1 兼容，并接受 12 位输入格式（截断为 10 位）。
  • 我们为 Playdate（带有曲柄的黄色小控制台）提供了视频编码器和混合器。 它使用 delta 编码和 zlib 压缩生成 1 位、400×240 视频。 这并不重要，但很酷。
  • 新的解码 API avcodec_receive_frame_flags() 具有 AV_CODEC_RECEIVE_FRAME_FLAG_SYNCHRONOUS 标志，可绕过帧线程延迟并尽快返回下一帧。 这对于在其余时间仍希望进行线程解码的低延迟消费者非常有用。

汇编和 SIMD：x86、NEON 和 RISC-V

FFmpeg 仍然编写汇编，这个周期很繁忙：近 200 次提交涉及 x86 目录，大约有 100 次提交涉及 ARM 目录。

在 x86 上，很大一部分工作是 Andreas Rheinhardt 将树中最古老的 DSP 代码拖到了现在：半像素运动补偿代码（hpeldsp 和 fpel，可以追溯到 MMX 时代）被移植到 SSE2，H.264 帧内预测获得 AVX2 水平预测器，pp7 后处理 DCT 将 MMX 抛在后面，最后的 MMX 残余物从 mpegvideoenc 中删除。 运动估计比较函数获得了中值 SAD 的 SSSE3 版本，新的 swscale x86 后端从 NASM 宏生成其 SIMD 内核，包括上面提到的 AVX2 调色板读取路径。

在 ARM 上，NEON yuv2rgb 路径经过重新设计，可以一次处理两行，跨打包 RGB、平面 GBR、16 位 RGB 和 yuva420p 输出，包括大端 16 位格式。 HEVC 内角度模式 10 和 26 得到了 NEON 实现，并且重新展开了 AAC SBR 和浮动 DSP 循环以更好地填充现代管道。 但最有趣的 ARM 工作隐藏在 swscale 中。 Ramiro Polla 在 rasm 之上构建了新的 AArch64 后端，rasm 是一个具有指令级 IR 和构建器 API 的小型汇编器框架。 它在构建时将链接的 NEON 内核生成为汇编文本，并旨在允许稍后生成运行时代码。

RISC-V 在本周期的 FFmpeg 中更加安静，针对 hevc_add_res 和 Pixelutils SAD 进行了 RVV 优化，并修复了可移植性。 多媒体生态系统中的大部分 RISC-V 矢量能量目前都进入了 dav1d，FFmpeg 通过其基于 dav1d 的 AV1 解码免费将其取回。

相机原始数据和 FFV1

此版本的主题之一是开源的相机原始视频。

8.0 中引入的原生 ProRes RAW 解码器与本周期的参考实现同步：它现在从比特流中解析线性化曲线，设置帧裁剪，并通过新的 AV_FRAME_DATA_RAW_COLOR_PARAMS 侧数据导出原始拜耳颜色参数，该数据设计为特定于编解码器，因为 ARRIRAW 已明确出现在路线图上。 GPU 加速的 Vulkan 解码器以及 Apple 平台上的新 VideoToolbox 解码器均可用。

在管道的另一边，FFV1 学会了对拜耳像素格式进行编码：原始传感器马赛克，无损压缩，无需先去拜耳。 Lynne 在本机编解码器中实现了它，每切片搜索最佳可逆颜色变换系数，并在单独的 GPU 加速的 Vulkan FFV1 编码器和解码器中实现（是的，FFmpeg 现在在 GPU 上编码和解码 FFV1）。 搜索作为其自己的计算通道运行。 部分工作由主权技术基金赞助。 Vulkan 编码器还通过 Rice-plus-remap 编码模式获得了 32 位浮点 RGB 路径，并在读取原始 16 位浮点时注意保留非正规值。 FFV1 广泛用于保存大师，以 GPU 速度无损压缩相机传感器数据是数字保存的一项有用的新功能。

Vulkan 和 GPU

Vulkan 工作不断扩展到编解码器和过滤层：

  • 新的 v360_vulkan 过滤器在计算着色器中进行 360° 投影重新映射，GPU 加速树中最昂贵的过滤器之一。
  • APV 是三星在 8.0 中添加的专业生产编解码器，配备了 Vulkan GPU 加速解码器。
  • 一个重大的基础设施变化：运行时着色器编译消失了。 现在，所有 Vulkan 着色器都在构建时编译为 SPIR-V，并且其余过滤器（scale、nlmeans、blackdetect）也进行了相应移植。 不再需要在运行时运送 GLSL 编译器来运行比例过滤器； swscale GLSL 后端被删除，取而代之的是 SPIR-V 后端。
  • Vulkan hwcontext API 针对重大改进进行了现代化：VkAccessFlagBits2、公开公开的队列创建标志、可查询的可选实例/设备扩展、新的像素格式支持（X2RGB10、X2BGR10、XV30、RGBAF16），以及一系列 CUDA 互操作性修复。

Vulkan 并不是唯一的 GPU API。 AMD 的 AMF 获得了帧速率转换器过滤器 (frc_amf)、颜色转换器中的 HDR 功能（vpp_amf，以及新的公共帮助程序，用于将 HDR 元数据与 AMF 表示进行相互转换）以及硬件内存映射支持。 CUDA 管道获得了一个新的 transpose_cuda 过滤器、scale_cuda 中的通用过滤路径，以及最新 NVIDIA 硬件最终可以解码的 10 位和 12 位 4:2:2 和 4:4:4 格式的端到端处理。 这些专业格式通过 NVDEC、CUDA 过滤器和 NVENC 等进行映射。

HDR 和杜比视界

十天前，我写了一篇有关 libbluray 1.5.0 在 UHD 蓝光光盘上公开杜比视界轨道的文章。 FFmpeg 9.0 接手了该管道的另一端，这一次故事已经完成。

杜比视界配置文件 7（UHD 蓝光光盘上使用的风格）是一种奇怪的野兽：完整的增强层 HEVC 比特流和 RPU 元数据在基础层流内交错，隐藏在未指定的 NAL 单元类型 62 和 63 中。 新的 dovi_split 比特流过滤器将这样的流分开：仅保留基础层并获得普通的标准 HEVC 流，或正确分离各层。 围绕它，libavformat 获得了一个真实的模型：杜比视觉流组（LCEVC 流组到 AVStreamGroupLayeredVideo 的概括），在解复用 MP4、MPEG-TS 和 Matroska 时检测到，并在复用到 MP4 或 Matroska 时再次写入，包括 hvcE 增强层配置。 这使得可以对这些流进行解复用、分割和重新复用，同时保持信令完好无损。

在元数据方面，9.0 添加了 SMPTE 2094-50 动态 HDR 元数据（与 HDR10+ 并列的另一种 SMPTE 2094 格式）的解析、写入和直通，以及使用 libaom 和 libvpx 进行编码、Matroska 块添加和 ffprobe 输出。 该规范正在所有地方的 GitHub 上公开最终确定。 是的，SMPTE 现在在 GitHub 上起草标准。 整个 ITU-T T.35 动态元数据动物园，包括 HDR10+、中国的 HDR Vivid、AOM 胶片颗粒和活动格式描述，现在通过一组统一的助手进行解析，而不是由编解码器重新实现。 如果您的文件携带错误的静态 HDR 元数据，则 ffmpeg CLI 会获得每个流的 -mastering_display 和 -content_light 输入覆盖，以更正输入上的元数据，任何处理过不良掌握的 HDR 文件的人都会欣赏这一点。

libav格式

近 400 个提交以 libavformat 形式提交。 除了上述杜比视界工作之外：

  • 新的解复用器命令 API (avformat_send_command() / avformat_receive_command_reply()) 允许应用程序与正在运行的解复用器通信。 第一个用户是 RTSP，公开 SET_PARAMETER，因此交互式摄像机控制不再需要带外连接。 该设计故意是异步的：您在命令及其回复之间不断读取数据包。
  • LCEVC 增强层现在可以作为 MP4 中的正确轨道进行复用，并作为 Matroska 中的 ITU-T T.35 块添加进行复用，从而完成两个版本前开始的 LCEVC 链。
  • MP4/MOV 获得了 TREF 流组来对轨道引用进行建模，因此定时元数据流（例如 EXIF 或摄像机遥测）始终附加到它们所描述的媒体、版本 1 chnl 框、stsd 版本 2（用于两个以上音频通道）以及导出初始填充和尾随样本修剪以实现无间隙音频。
  • 新的共享：协议实现了并发块缓存：线程安全且跨进程，因此读取同一远程流的多个 FFmpeg 实例可以共享单个缓存文件。 它是内存映射的，有一个很好的副作用：一旦流被完全读取，缓存文件就是流文件的工作副本。 作者：Niklas Haas，当时他没有重写 swscale。
  • IAMF，开放媒体联盟的沉浸式音频格式（Eclipsa Audio 下的格式），获得了其动态参数，包括混合增益、解混合信息和侦查增益，以正确的帧侧数据形式公开，可通过 ffprobe 和 showinfo 过滤器打印；马文·肖尔茨着。 IAMF 复用器现在通过新的 AVFMT_FIXED_FRAMESIZE 功能标志强制执行格式的固定帧大小，而不是默默地生成损坏的文件。
  • 在网络方面：WHIP 复用器现在需要并验证来自 SDP 答案的远程 DTLS 指纹，mbedTLS 得到了修复以实际检查外部套接字上的证书验证结果，RTMP、FTP 和 RTSP 都收到了输入验证强化。

大清理

8.x 周期中弃用的所有内容都消失了，而且列表很长。

在命令行上，-vsync 最终被删除（使用 -fps_mode），以及 -top、-qphist、-filter_complex_script 和 -adrift_threshold。 OpenMAX 编码器已被删除。 NPP 过滤器（scale_npp、scale2ref_npp、sharpen_npp、transpose_npp）与 libnpp 支持的其余部分一起消失，已于去年 9 月弃用；上面提到的 transpose_cuda 过滤器从 transpose_npp 停止的地方开始，没有外部依赖。 打包的 YUV 怪异 v308/v408/v410 失去了专用编解码器。 NVENC 放弃了旧的预设别名、旧的速率控制模式以及对 11.1 之前版本的 SDK 的支持。

一项行为变化值得大家关注：FFmpeg 现在默认验证 TLS 对等证书。 这是在 8.0 中宣布的，并在这次升级中应用，完全按照承诺。 如果您的脚本与证书损坏的服务器通信，那么它们无论如何都是靠借来的时间生存的。

不过，我最喜欢的两个删除是纯粹的 FFmpeg 传说：

  • 独立的 CELT 解码器消失了（这不会影响 Opus，它包含自己的 CELT）。 提交消息指出，它实际上自 2014 年以来就已被破坏，“没有人注意到并抱怨”。 十一年的无声比特腐烂，被 VideoLAN 自己的马文·肖尔茨 (Marvin Scholz) 删除了。
  • Sonic 编解码器（Michael Niedermayer 在 2000 年代初的实验性编解码器系列）也被删除。 拆除工作原定于上一次重大突破时进行，但错过了最后期限。 如果您在某个地方有 Sonic 文件，并且从统计数据来看您没有，请尽可能使用 8.x 版本对它们进行转码。

命令行

-re/-readrate 机制经过重新设计，以限制最慢的流而不是最快的流，跳过已完成和尚未启动的流。 如果您曾经遇到过由于字幕轨道稀疏而无法进行实时重播的情况，那么这就是您的解决方法。 ffprobe 学会了打印新的辅助数据类型（SMPTE 2094-50、IAMF 混合增益和解混合参数、缩混信息），并且 ffmpeg CLI 现在可以在复用时创建 LCEVC 流组。

DNN 过滤器获得带有 CUDA 和 DirectML 执行提供程序的 ONNX 运行时后端，因此您可以直接在过滤器图中运行 ONNX 模型以实现超分辨率、去噪或背景去除，而无需先将其转换为 TensorFlow 或 OpenVINO。 与 8.0 中的 Whisper 过滤器相结合，过滤器图正在成为在解码循环旁边运行推理的好地方。

在引擎盖下

一些不太明显的变化也值得一提：

  • FFmpeg 的汇编测试现在使用独立的 checkasm 库，该项目是我在 dav1d 1.5.4 帖子中提到的：诞生于 x264，在 FFmpeg 中重写，为 dav1d 重新授权，现在为每个人维护一次。
  • 开发现在在 code.ffmpeg.org 上的 FFmpeg 自己的 Forgejo 实例以及邮件列表上运行； GitHub 拉取请求“将被忽略”。
  • 在这个周期的 160 多个贡献者中，有一个是自动化贡献者：一个错误查找机器人在分路器和协议中植入了 9 个可接受的强化补丁，以及来自 OSS-Fuzz 的连续模糊测试修复流。

结论

FFmpeg 9.0 是一个重大版本，具有新功能以及大量清理工作。 ABI 中断意味着发行版和应用程序将需要一些时间来迁移七个新的 soname，VLC 也将随之而来。

完整的更新日志值得一读，git 日志也值得一读；祝贺编写此版本的 160 多名人员，特别是 Niklas Haas、Andreas Rheinhardt、Michael Niedermayer、James Almer、Lynne、Marvin Scholz 和 Ramiro Polla，他们名列长长名单之首，其中几位在 FFlabs 和/或 VideoLabs 参与了这项工作。

该代码一如既往地是开源的。 欢迎补丁。
